newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus in deal with Columbia/TriStar.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus in deal with Columbia/TriStar.

text.p: Canal Plus said on Tuesday that it and Sony's Columbia TriStar International Television unit signed a long-term agreement concerning the broadcast of Columbia/TriStar films on Canal Plus and its Kiosque satellite pay-per-view channel.

The company gave no financial details about the deal, but said it would enable Canal Plus to offer exclusively to its own subscribers, and to those of Kiosque, recent Sony Pictures Entertainment films.
Canal Plus also said it would show films from the extensive Columbia Pictures film library.
